stories.title: Orangeburg County residents push to restore civil rights activist's name to community center
stories.summary: Some Orangeburg County residents want civil rights activist John Stroman's name restored to a community center renamed in 2019.

stories.title: Columbia residents opposing North Main Street gas station score another victory
stories.summary: Columbia City Council voted 5-2 against a zoning amendment that could have helped clear the way for a proposed Murphy gas station on North Main Street.

stories.title: Susan Smith seeks parole again Thursday, two years after unanimous rejection
stories.summary: The South Carolina woman convicted of drowning her two young sons in 1994 will appear before the parole board for the second time.

stories.title: Gov.-elect Alan Wilson asks South Carolina agency leaders to apply to keep their jobs
stories.summary: Gov.-elect Alan Wilson has given South Carolina agency leaders until December 4 to express interest in continuing under his administration.

stories.title: Midlands church aims to erase $2.5 million in medical debt for Lexington, Richland County residents
stories.summary: A Midlands church and nonprofit are working to eliminate medical debt for qualifying Lexington and Richland County residents. Here's how the effort works.

stories.title: How much will Thanksgiving dinner cost this year? Here's what shoppers are spending
stories.summary: According to the American Farm Bureau Federation, the average cost of a traditional Thanksgiving meal for 10 people this year is about $58.63

stories.title: Inmate who walked away from Spring Valley work crew captured about an hour later
stories.summary: A South Carolina inmate who walked away from a labor crew in Spring Valley was apprehended about an hour later by Richland County deputies.

stories.title: SC State to offer new animal and veterinary sciences bachelor's degree in fall 2027
stories.summary: SC State's new animal and veterinary sciences degree will offer pre-vet and industry concentrations with hands-on training beginning in fall 2027.

stories.title: South Carolina leaders urge FCC to pass rules allowing prisons to jam contraband cell phones
stories.summary: South Carolina corrections officials say Broad River Correctional Institution in Columbia would be the first facility in the state to use the technology.

stories.title: Body found in shallow grave in Lee County, sheriff says
stories.summary: A farmer discovered the body Tuesday afternoon while preparing a field along Scottsville Road. Authorities are investigating the death as suspicious.

stories.title: 8-year-old brings knife to Richland County elementary school, deputies say
stories.summary: Deputies said the knife was discovered when another student look into the child's bookbag.

stories.title: How to watch Susan Smith's parole hearing live Thursday
stories.summary: Smith, convicted of murdering her two young sons in 1994, is seeking parole again after the board unanimously denied her release in 2024.
